preview.//: An APK you can sideload onto a phone. 'internal' makes the build URL install directly; 'apk' switches the Gradle task from bundleRelease to assembleRelease, which is what stops it producing an AAB the Play Store wants and a phone cannot open.

development.//: A dev client: the same native code, but it loads JS from the Metro server, so a change shows up without another 20-minute build. This is also the only kind of build where Android push notifications work — Expo Go dropped them in SDK 53.
